sources.title: [2512.13961] Olmo 3 - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce Olmo 3, a family of state-of-the-art, fully-open language models at the 7B and 32B parameter scales. Olmo 3 model construction targets long-context reasoning, function calling, coding, instruction following, general chat, and knowledge recall. sources.title: Olmo 3 7B Instruct (7B) — MMLU 76, HumanEval 72 - OpenModelMap
sources.snippet: Olmo 3 7B Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter instruction-following model from Allen AI, supporting 64K long context. As a representative of open-source high performance, it excels in code generation, logical reasoning, and general dialogue.
